name: game-earcons
description: 8-bit sound cues on macOS, Windows and Linux: a permission prompt or question waiting on you, a long turn finished, an error, a guard refusing a call, a save

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: off is silent; casual plays ask, block, save, errors and turns of minTurnSeconds or longer; hardcore adds every turn, failed tool calls and file changes

minTurnSeconds.title: Done cue after (seconds)
minTurnSeconds.description: In casual, a finished turn plays the done cue only when it took at least this long
